title: Mini mission · Level 2: Cubes home, then park
brief: Push the red cube into the red zone and the blue cube into the blue zone (each wholly inside, on the far wall), then park the whole robot in the garage (bottom right, its black outline). The cubes stand up to 20 mm each way (along and across) from their level-1 places, a new place each run. The run ends when your program ends, or at 120 s (the round); it finishes when the program ends within the round. 35 for each cube wholly in its zone, 20 for the whole robot inside the garage when the run ends, 10 for no field damage. No speed points: the mean time (par 50 s) only breaks ties.
